articles.summary: "Wheaton delivered another solid quarter, building on record year-to-date performance, and remains very well positioned to achieve our annual production guidance," said Haytham Hodaly, President and Chief Executive Officer of Wheaton Precious Metals. "We continued to see meaningful progress on our growth pipeline, with first gold pour at Montage Gold's Koné project and Hudbay's approval of construction at Copper World marking important milestones for two significant contributors to our near-term growth. With a portfolio of high-quality assets and increasing visibility into our next phase of growth, supported by a strong financial position, we are confident in Wheaton's outlook and our ability to deliver meaningful production growth over the coming years." articles.summary: Wheaton Precious Metals™ Corp. ("Wheaton" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that its Board of Directors has declared its fourth quarterly cash dividend payment for 2026 of US$0.195 per common share, an 18% increase from the fourth quarterly cash dividend declared in 2025. The fourth quarterly cash dividend for 2026 will be paid to holders of record of Wheaton common shares as of the close of business on November 19, 2026, and will be distributed on or about December 3, 2026. The ex-dividend trading date is November 19, 2026. The declaration, timing, amount and payment of future dividends remain at the discretion of the Board of Directors. This dividend qualifies as an 'eligible dividend' for Canadian income tax purposes. Dividend Reinvestment Plan The Company has previously implemented a Dividend Reinvestment Plan ("DRIP").
